paragraphs: Abba Yosi Choli Kofri of Tivon.
Mentioned in Mishnah Makhshirin, chapter 1, mishnah 3; R' Yehoshua reported in his name.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Choli Kofri preserves the compound designation חלי קופרי without inventing its meaning; of Tivon retains the locality qualifier without identity admission. Earlier provisional heading/identity status remains unadjudicated.

The source explicitly names Mishnah Makhshirin and פ״א מ״ג, chapter 1 mishnah 3, without an independently checked edition. Yehoshua reports Abba Yosi, not the reverse. Abba is full; Yehoshua remains R'.
